title: Twelve skills, one growth system.
intro: Each discipline feeds the others. Social builds attention, search captures intent, paid media scales what works and analytics keeps it all accountable.

groups.title: Social & Community
groups.summary: Building audiences that recognise, trust and talk about the brand.

skills.name: Social Media Management
skills.description: Day-to-day planning, scheduling and publishing across platforms with a consistent brand voice.

skills.name: Social Media Marketing
skills.description: Campaigns and content formats designed to grow reach, engagement and followers with intent.

skills.name: Community Management
skills.description: Replying, moderating and nurturing conversations so followers become loyal advocates.

skills.name: LinkedIn Marketing & Outreach
skills.description: Profile positioning, thought-leadership content and targeted outreach to decision makers.

groups.title: Paid & Performance
groups.summary: Turning budget into measurable leads and sales.

skills.name: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
skills.description: Audience research, creative testing and campaign structure built around cost per result.

skills.name: Lead Generation
skills.description: Funnels, lead magnets and forms that capture qualified prospects, not just clicks.

skills.name: E-commerce & Shopify Promotion
skills.description: Product launches, catalogue ads and promotions that drive traffic and sales to Shopify stores.

groups.title: Search & Content
groups.summary: Being found at the exact moment people are looking.

skills.name: YouTube SEO
skills.description: Keyword-led titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnails that help videos rank and get watched.

skills.name: Website SEO
skills.description: On-page optimisation, keyword mapping and technical fixes that grow organic traffic.

skills.name: Content Strategy & Planning
skills.description: Content pillars, calendars and briefs that keep every channel on-message and on schedule.

groups.title: Growth & Insight
groups.summary: Connecting marketing activity to business outcomes.

skills.name: Business Development
skills.description: Identifying opportunities, building partnerships and opening new revenue channels.

skills.name: Analytics & Reporting
skills.description: Clear dashboards and reports that turn platform data into decisions.
